FM-0030B created and started: fix live Regrid search normalization. The live v2 API nests candidate groups under parcels/buildings/zoning and parcel attributes under properties.fields, so address search returns zero candidates and resolved candidates lose APN, address, city, state, county, and acreage.

FM-0030B completed: Regrid normalization now reads the live v2 grouped response (parcels/buildings/zoning) and the nested properties.fields attributes, so address search returns real candidates with APN, address, city, state, county, zip, acreage, coordinates, and geometry intact. Also corrected two request-side mismatches found during live verification: APN search sent apn instead of parcelnumb (HTTP 400) and parcel lookup used an unversioned path that 404s.
